FAT TO FIT WITH Z

Helping Women Build Healthier, Stronger & More Sustainable Lifestyles

Fat To Fit With Z is an online women's health and fitness platform dedicated to helping women achieve their health, weight management, fitness, and lifestyle goals through practical and personalized guidance.
We focus on nutrition, clinical health, hormonal wellness, weight management, and fitness, supporting women with different health conditions and lifestyle needs through practical approaches that can be followed in everyday life.

OUR MISSION

Our mission is simple: to help women achieve their health and fitness goals without extreme restrictions.
We believe sustainable results come from creating the right balance of nutrition, movement, consistency, and a healthy lifestyle.

ABOUT THE COACH

I am a passionate Nutrition Professional and Certified Fitness Coach, dedicated to helping women build healthier, stronger, and more sustainable lifestyles.
My approach focuses on understanding individual needs and creating practical guidance around nutrition, health, fitness, lifestyle, and personal goals.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.)
• Master’s Degree in Dietetics
• Advanced Qualification in Clinical Nutrition
• Professional Certification in Hormonal Health & Hormonal Imbalance Management
• Certified Fitness Coach

AREAS OF EXPERTISE

• Clinical Nutrition & Dietetics
• Weight Management — Healthy Loss & Gain
• PCOS & Hormonal Health Management
• Diabetes & Blood Sugar Control
• Cholesterol & Fatty Liver Management
• Uric Acid & Menopause Management
• Lifestyle Modification & Fitness Coaching

OUR APPROACH

Every woman has different goals, routines, food preferences, health needs, and fitness levels.
That's why our approach focuses on practical and personalized guidance rather than a one-size-fits-all method.

Our goal is to help women develop sustainable routines that combine:

• Balanced nutrition
• Regular movement
• Consistency
• Healthy lifestyle habits
• Personalized support

A HEALTHIER LIFESTYLE STARTS WITH THE RIGHT GUIDANCE

Whether your goal is healthy weight management, improving fitness, building healthier habits, or working toward specific health and lifestyle goals, Fat To Fit With Z is designed to provide structured guidance and ongoing support throughout your journey.

START YOUR JOURNEY
Choose the program that fits your goals and take the first step toward a healthier, stronger, and more sustainable lifestyle.

EXPLORE OUR PROGRAMS

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

How Can We Help?

Find answers to common questions about our programs, memberships, workouts, diet plans, payments and support.

General Questions

What is FAT TO FIT WITH Z?

FAT TO FIT WITH Z is an online women's health and fitness platform designed to help women achieve their health, weight management, fitness, and lifestyle goals through practical and sustainable guidance.

We provide customized diet plans, recorded workout sessions/plans, progress tracking, e-books, and ongoing support to help women build healthier and more sustainable lifestyles.

Who can join the programs?

Our programs are designed primarily for women of different ages and fitness levels, including:

  • Beginners who don't know where to start
  • Women looking for sustainable weight loss
  • Women who want to become stronger and more active
  • Housewives who prefer working out from home
  • Working women with busy schedules
  • Women looking for structured diet and workout guidance
  • Women who want accountability and consistency
  • Women returning to fitness after a long break

Are the programs suitable for beginners?

Yes, absolutely. Our programs include beginner-friendly options and modifications wherever needed. You can start according to your current fitness level and gradually progress at a comfortable pace.

Do I need a gym membership?

No. Our workouts are designed to be done from home. Depending on the program, workouts may include:

  • Bodyweight exercises
  • Simple home-based movements
  • Dumbbells or water bottles
  • Resistance bands
  • Other easily available household props

How does the customized diet plan work?

Before creating your plan, we collect information about your goals, current weight and measurements, daily routine, food preferences, eating habits, activity level, lifestyle, and relevant health information.

Based on this information, a personalized and practical diet plan is created according to your individual needs and goals.

Do I have to eat special or expensive foods?

No. Our diet plans are designed to be practical and can be adjusted according to your regular lifestyle and food preferences. The goal is to help you make healthier choices and create sustainable eating habits without extreme restrictions.

Is the diet plan the same for everyone?

No. Every person has different goals, lifestyles, food preferences, routines, and requirements. Therefore, customized diet plans are created according to individual needs rather than following a one-size-fits-all approach.

Do you prescribe supplements or recommend specific brands?

No. We do not provide supplementation plans, nor do we prescribe or promote any specific supplement brands. Our main focus is on practical, sustainable nutrition through natural food sources.

Do I need to submit medical lab reports to join?

No, we do not require you to share detailed medical lab reports. Sharing your medical diagnosis or relevant health conditions (if any) during the initial evaluation is enough for us to tailor your diet and guidance safely.

What types of workouts are included?

Depending on your selected program or membership, you may receive access to recorded workout sessions/plans including:

  • Home-based workouts
  • Strength training
  • Cardio workouts
  • Full-body workouts
  • Pilates-inspired workouts
  • Stretching and mobility sessions
  • Beginner-friendly workouts

Workout content and access may vary according to your selected package.

Membership FAQs

What do I get with my membership?

Your membership benefits will depend on the package you choose. Depending on your selected program, your membership may include:

  • Personalized diet plan
  • Recorded workout sessions / workout plan
  • E-books and helpful guides
  • Progress tracking
  • Weekly check-ins
  • Meal submission and tracking
  • Access to the Member Dashboard
  • Ongoing guidance and accountability

What are the e-books included in the membership?

Depending on your selected package, members may receive access to exclusive e-books and guides related to health, nutrition, fitness, weight management, healthy habits, and lifestyle improvement.

The availability of e-books may vary according to the membership package.

How do I access my membership?

After successfully joining a program, you will receive access to your Member Dashboard.

Depending on your membership, the dashboard may include your personalized diet plan, recorded workout sessions / workout plan, e-books, progress tracking forms, weekly check-in forms, daily meal submission forms, and important program updates.

How long will I have access to the membership?

Your access period depends on the package or program you purchase. Each program will clearly mention program duration, membership validity, included services, and access period.

Can I freeze my package or membership?

Yes, a package freeze option may be available under specific circumstances. If you are temporarily unable to continue your program due to a valid reason, you can contact the support team to request a package freeze.

The duration and eligibility for freezing a package will depend on the terms of your selected membership.

Can I upgrade my membership?

Yes, where available. If you want additional services or access to a higher-level package, you may be able to upgrade your membership according to the available options.

Payments & Support

How can I make a payment?

Available payment methods will be displayed during the checkout process. Payment options may vary depending on your country and the selected program.

Is my payment secure?

Payments made through the website will be processed through the available secure payment system. Please make sure you complete your payment only through the official website or officially provided payment instructions.

What kind of support will I receive?

Support depends on your selected package. Depending on your membership, support may include program-related guidance, weekly check-ins, progress monitoring, accountability, guidance related to your diet and workout plan / recorded sessions, and support regarding the Member Dashboard.

How often will my progressbe checked?

Progress monitoring depends on your selected package and may include weekly check-ins, weight updates, measurement tracking, progress photos (if applicable), and review of consistency and progress.

How quickly will I see results?

Results vary from person to person and depend on factors such as starting point, consistency, nutrition, physical activity, sleep, lifestyle, and individual body differences.

We focus on healthy, realistic, and sustainable progress rather than promising instant results.

What happens if I cannot follow the plan perfectly?

That's completely okay. Progress does not require perfection. The goal is to build consistency and sustainable habits. If you have an occasional off day, simply get back to your routine and continue your journey.

Can I join from another country?

Yes. Our online platform allows women from different countries to join and access their available membership services online.

Is this a medical service?

No. Our services focus on nutrition guidance, fitness, lifestyle improvement, and general wellness support.

For medical diagnosis, treatment, medication-related concerns, or serious health conditions, you should consult your qualified healthcare professional.

Still have questions?

We're here to help! If you cannot find the answer to your question, please contact us through our official support channels for assistance regarding programs, memberships, payments, or your account.

Still Have Questions?

We're here to help. Contact our support team for assistance regarding programs, memberships, payments, or your account.

At Fat to Fit with Z, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information you provide when using our website and services.

This Privacy Policy explains what information we may collect, how it may be used and how it may be protected.

1. Information We May Collect

Depending on the services you use, we may collect information such as:

- Name
- Email address
- Phone number
- Account and login information
- Payment and transaction information
- Age and general demographic information
- Fitness and lifestyle information
- Dietary preferences and information
- Information provided through progress forms and check-ins
- Information necessary to provide personalized nutrition or fitness services

2. How We Use Your Information

We may use your information to:

- Create and manage your account
- Process payments
- Provide purchased programs and services
- Prepare personalized nutrition or fitness guidance
- Track progress and provide check-ins
- Communicate with you about your program
- Provide customer support
- Improve our website and services
- Send important service-related communications
- Comply with applicable legal requirements

3. Payment Information

Payments may be processed through third-party payment providers.

Fat to Fit with Z does not intentionally retain complete payment card details when payment processing is handled by an authorized third-party payment provider.

Payment information may be subject to the privacy policies and terms of the relevant payment provider.

4. Sharing of Information

We do not sell your personal information.

Information may be shared with trusted service providers where reasonably necessary to operate our website, process payments, provide services, manage communications, or maintain our technical systems.

We may also disclose information where required by applicable law or legal process.

5. Health & Dietary Information

If you provide health, dietary, fitness or lifestyle information for the purpose of receiving personalized services, that information will be used for providing and managing those services.

You should only provide information that is relevant and necessary for your participation and service delivery.

6. Cookies & Website Technologies

Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to improve website functionality, understand website usage and provide a better user experience.

Third-party services used on our website may also use cookies or similar technologies according to their own policies.

7. Data Security

We take reasonable measures to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse or disclosure.

However, no online transmission or electronic storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

8. Data Retention

We may retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide our services, maintain business records, resolve disputes, comply with legal obligations and protect our legitimate business interests.

9. Your Rights

Depending on applicable law, you may have rights regarding your personal information, including requesting access to, correction of, or deletion of certain information.

Requests may be submitted to:

fattofitwithz@gmail.com

10. Third-Party Services

Our website may contain links to or integrate with third-party platforms or services.

We are not responsible for the privacy practices of third-party websites or services. We encourage users to review the privacy policies of those services separately.

11. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.

Any updated version will be published on this page with a revised effective date.

12. Contact

For questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact:

Fat to Fit with Z
Email: fattofitwithz@gmail.com

At Fat to Fit with Z, our programs may include workout sessions, digital content, personalized resources, nutrition guidance and other services.

1. Refund Policy

All program purchases are non-refundable once the program has been activated or access to the purchased content or services has been provided, subject to any rights that may apply under applicable law.

This includes:

- Workout sessions
- Recorded workout sessions
- Diet plans
- PDFs and digital resources
- Program access
- Personalized plans
- Progress tracking
- Check-ins
- Other services included in the purchased package

2. Change of Mind

Refunds will generally not be provided because a client:
- Changes their mind after purchasing
- Decides not to continue
- Does not use the program
- Does not attend workout sessions
- Does not follow the diet or workout plan
- Does not achieve the expected results
- Becomes too busy to participate

Clients are encouraged to review the program description and included services before purchasing.

3. Duplicate Payments

If a client is accidentally charged more than once for the same purchase, the duplicate transaction may be reviewed and, where verified, the duplicate payment may be refunded.

4. Technical Issues

If a genuine technical issue prevents access to a purchased service, the client should contact:

fattofitwithz@gmail.com

We will make reasonable efforts to resolve the issue or restore access.

A technical issue does not automatically qualify for a refund if the issue can reasonably be resolved.

5. Freeze Policy

Where a program includes a freeze option, the freeze must be requested according to the terms applicable to that specific package.

A freeze temporarily pauses the client's program access or participation period, where applicable. It does not constitute a refund.

Freeze requests made outside the applicable freeze period or after the program has expired may not be accepted.

6. Cancellation

Once a paid program has been activated or accessed, cancellation does not automatically create an entitlement to a refund.

If a cancellation request is made before access has been activated, it may be reviewed according to the terms of the purchased program and applicable law.

7. Workout Session Changes

If a workout session is postponed, rescheduled or cancelled due to circumstances on our side, an alternative session, recording or reasonable replacement may be provided where applicable.

A change to a particular workout session schedule does not automatically qualify for a refund.

8. Program Results

We do not guarantee specific weight-loss, fat-loss, measurement, fitness or health outcomes.

Failure to achieve a particular result does not qualify for a refund.

9. Exceptional Circumstances

Requests outside this policy may be reviewed individually.

Where required by applicable law, statutory consumer rights will continue to apply.

10. Refund & Cancellation Queries

All refund, cancellation or freeze requests should be sent to:

Fat to Fit with Z
Email: fattofitwithz@gmail.com

Please include your registered name, email address, purchased program and relevant payment information.

By purchasing a program, you acknowledge that you have read and accepted this Refund, Cancellation & Freeze Policy.

Welcome to Fat to Fit with Z. These Terms & Services govern your use of our website, fitness programs, workout sessions, nutrition services, diet plans, recorded content, and related services.

By registering, purchasing a program, making a payment, or using our website and services, you agree to these Terms & Services.

1. Our Services

Fat to Fit with Z provides wellness services that may include:

- Workout sessions
- Live fitness sessions
- Recorded workout sessions
- Nutrition and diet plans
- Personalized or condition-specific nutrition guidance
- Progress tracking and check-ins
- Educational nutrition and wellness content
- PDFs, meal guides, workout plans and other digital resources
- Support related to the purchased program

The exact services available depend on the package or program purchased.

2. Eligibility & User Information

You agree to provide accurate and complete information when registering for our services.

You are responsible for ensuring that the information you provide, including relevant health, dietary, lifestyle and fitness information, is accurate and up to date.

Our programs are intended for adults unless otherwise stated.

3. Health & Medical Disclaimer

Our services are designed for general wellness, fitness, nutrition education and lifestyle support.

They are not a substitute for medical diagnosis, treatment or emergency medical care.

If you have a medical condition, injury, are pregnant or postpartum, take medication, or have been advised to restrict physical activity or follow a specific diet, consult an appropriate healthcare professional before participating.

You are responsible for informing us about any relevant health information that may affect your participation.

4. Workout Participation

Physical activity involves inherent risks, including muscle soreness, strains, falls, injuries or other physical complications.

You participate in workout sessions voluntarily and are responsible for exercising according to your own ability.

Modifications may be provided where applicable. However, we cannot guarantee that every exercise or workout session will be suitable for every individual.

5. Nutrition Services

Nutrition plans and recommendations are prepared based on the information provided by the client.

Individual results vary depending on factors including adherence, lifestyle, activity level, sleep, health conditions, medications, genetics and other circumstances.

No specific amount of weight loss, fat loss, measurement change or other result is guaranteed.

6. Program & Account Access

After successful payment, you may receive access to the services and materials included in your selected package.

These may include workout sessions, recorded sessions, diet plans, PDFs, progress forms, check-ins and other program materials.

Access is personal to the purchaser and may not be shared, transferred, copied, resold or distributed.

7. Workout Sessions & Recordings

Workout session schedules may occasionally change because of operational, technical, personal or other unavoidable circumstances.

Where applicable, recordings or alternative sessions may be provided.

We do not guarantee uninterrupted access to services at all times where interruptions are caused by circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

8. Intellectual Property

All workout videos, diet plans, PDFs, guides, educational materials, written content, graphics, recordings and other materials provided by Fat to Fit with Z are for personal use only.

You may not copy, reproduce, distribute, sell, upload, commercially use or redistribute our content without prior written permission.

9. Payments

Program prices are displayed on the website at the time of purchase.

Payment must be completed through the available payment methods before access to the relevant paid services is provided.

Prices, packages and services may change for future purchases.

10. Cancellation, Refunds & Freezing

All purchases are subject to our separate Refund, Cancellation & Freeze Policy.

11. Technical Requirements

You are responsible for having a suitable device, internet connection and any required applications needed to access our services.

We are not responsible for interruptions caused by your device, internet service provider, software or other circumstances outside our reasonable control.

12. User Conduct

You agree not to use our website or services for unlawful purposes or in a way that may damage, interfere with or compromise our website, platform, content or services.

We may restrict or terminate access if a user violates these Terms, misuses our services, shares paid content or engages in abusive or inappropriate conduct.

13. Results Disclaimer

Fat to Fit with Z does not guarantee specific results.

Testimonials, photographs, measurements or examples shown on our website or social media represent individual experiences and should not be interpreted as a guarantee of similar results.

14. Changes to Services or Terms

We may update our services, programs, pricing, website features or these Terms & Services from time to time.

Updated Terms will become effective when published on the website.

15. Contact

Fat to Fit with Z
Email: fattofitwithz@gmail.com

By purchasing or using our services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood and agreed to these Terms & Services.
